lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: Planning two kinds of food every day, mine and Zayan's.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: Instamart mostly, Blinkit sometimes.
A: Later for sign in.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: Instamart's the main one. Blinkit if Instamart doesn't have something.
Q: I have Farah (34) and Zayan (2) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: Just me and Zayan.
Q: Shabana cooks Mon-Fri: Dinner at 5pm. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: Yes, Shabana comes Mon-Fri at 5 for dinner only. She has an hour.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: She has an hour, so just one dish for dinner, maybe two if it's simple.
Q: On Saturday and Sunday, when the cook doesn't come, who cooks? Or is a meal eaten out?
A: I cook on weekends. Saturday dinner I order in for myself.
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Zayan had suji upma, banana pancake, idli and ragi porridge over the week.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: Zayan is 2, he doesn't go to school. At home he has khichdi or dal rice, mashed. On daycare days they feed him.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: Zayan has khichdi, dal rice or vegetable daliya, mashed, every night for dinner.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Me: paratha with chai, bread omelette, or upma.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Dal chawal, roti and a sabzi mostly. Chicken biryani on Sunday.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Roti with chicken curry or a sabzi and dal. Fish curry on Friday, mutton curry maybe once a month.
A: oh, fish is on Wednesdays now, not Fridays
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: nobody on a diet here
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: We eat everything halal, no pork. Zayan is allergic to cashews, so no nuts at all for him. No sugar for Zayan, less salt too.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Only Saturday dinner I order in for myself.
A: Rest I cook or Shabana makes.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: Milkman comes every morning for milk. That's it.
